description: Check that a record still says what was signed: the permitted or refused decision, unchanged, under Seal's published issuer keys or a key you supply. Handles both formats: ATTESTATION-v1 (a model-call decision) and ACTION-v1 (an agent tool action). No Aqta service in the check.

profile.description: Usually omit this. The record's own signed version tag selects the format, and ATTESTATION-v1 is the default. Pass 'ACTION-v1' only to force an agent-action record to be checked as one.

public_key.description: Base64url Ed25519 key to check against. Omit it to check against Seal's published issuer keys; a record carrying any other key then fails. A key you supply is used as given, and issuer_key in the result says whether it is a Seal issuer key.

receipt.description: The record, as a JSON object or a JSON string.

name: verify_receipt
title: Verify a receipt
